newsitem.title: USA: Maine set to select new treasurer.
newsitem.headline: Maine set to select new treasurer.

text.p: Democratic lawmakers, who hold a majority in both branches of the Maine Legislature, Tuesday nominated retiring state Sen. Dale McCormick to be the state's next treasurer.

McCormick will face Republican David Bourne, who served as comptroller under former Gov. John McKernan, when the Legislature convenes Wednesday. Current Treasurer Sam Shapiro is leaving office because of term limits.

Democrats also selected retiring House Speaker Dan Gwadosky to be Secretary of State and renominated Andrew Ketterer to be attorney general. Maine is the only state where constitutional officers are selected entirely by the legislature.
McCormick, of Hallowell, unsuccessfully sought her party's congressional nomination this year.
